projection.rule: Every absolute local location in JSON keys and strings is replaced by its declared public location role or published artifact path; all other keys, values and statistical fields retained.

record.audio_scope: 16 kHz English read speech, resampled to mono 48 kHz for this codec; not native-wideband microphone/conversation/multilingual/mobile validation

metadata.rule: Official SPEAKERS.TXT line order; numeric ID, sex F/M, exact subset fields; no name/audio/transcript filtering

selection.speaker_rule: For EACH subset take first TWO eligible F and first TWO eligible M readers in official metadata order after excluding every exposed ID; no selection from audio
selection.clip_rule: For EACH selected voice retain the first TWO .flac members encountered in its official gzip/tar archive order across all chapters; archive order, not lexical sorting
selection.exclusions: NONE based on length, silence, signal quality, intelligibility, transcript, metric or result
selection.replacement: NEVER replace any selected voice or clip. Missing members/download corruption are protocol/data failures, not permission to substitute.

record.archive_proof: Download immutable complete archives, verify official MD5 and record SHA256/bytes/source URL; validate archive SPEAKERS metadata against pinned metadata; retain global member ordinal, member name, uncompressed FLAC byte count and SHA256 for each selection. Extract only selected FLACs and metadata, never arbitrary archive paths. No audio decode/listening/metrics during selection.

baseline.baseline_rule: Prefer one shared immutable main91 roundtrip/probe for both candidates. Any use of the other frozen main91 roundtrip must first prove full packet/aligned-PCM identity on every selected row, record its identity, and never mix unlabelled baselines.

matrix.unit: 8 independent voice IDs,16 correlated clips,96 repeated condition/duration observations per candidate; not96 independent people

input_pipeline.noise_function: Unchanged evaluate_speech.noisy; Python Random.gauss, whole-clip RMS scaling,20/10dB,[-1,1] clamp,f32le; record clean/mixed PCM hashes and clipping count
input_pipeline.dither_function: Unchanged evaluate_quality.intelligibility: SHA256 string first4bytes little-endian numpy seed, reset for each baseline/current pair; same STOI then ESTOI order
input_pipeline.drain: One separate drain packet, exactly120 samples, same15/30bytequota; never count drain as a normal input frame
input_pipeline.alignment: Existing roundtrip removes the same120-sample delay and preserves original sample count; no second re-alignment or truncation

metrics.reference_STOI_ESTOI: Clean resampled speech in all conditions
metrics.reference_SNR_LSD: Actual encoder input, including fixed mixed noise when present
metrics.recorded_precision: Canonical6decimal BASELINE/CURRENT; all deltas/gates from exact Decimal subtraction and means of those recorded endpoints, not separately rounded delta columns or hidden precision

gate.unit: Each candidate evaluated separately against the same matched main91; six condition/duration cells each contain16 fixed clips
gate.clean_mean: At EACH duration mean delta STOI>0 AND mean delta ESTOI>0
gate.noisy_mean: At EACH duration and EACH noise20/noise10 condition mean delta STOI>=0 AND mean delta ESTOI>=0
gate.clean_individual: EVERY clean clip/duration delta STOI>=-0.01 AND delta ESTOI>=-0.01
gate.SNR_LSD: No hidden pass thresholds; every value and regression retained
gate.missing_metric: Retain every selected row with explicit metric_status/reason; no replacement, exclusion, silent zero or fabricated score. If <1s, silent/unviable STOI, warning or other documented metric precondition failure prevents scoring, retain available outputs/hash/protocol proof and mark affected gates UNEVALUABLE, neverPASS from a smaller denominator. Operational failures are reported FAIL, not missingmetric wins.
gate.other_hard_contracts: Verify full packet trace/profile counts,validframe/CRC/drain/budget/120delay,finite[-1,1]PCM and exactlength before accepting rows; malformed or missing outputs are failure
gate.reporting: ALL96 expected keys per candidate,all baselines/currents/deltas,all regressions,count/profile/drain/fulltrace/PCM/input/source/probe/evaluator hashes and arguments. Report aggregate6cells,subset/gender/voice descriptives without posthoc split gates or96-person significance claim.

execution.current_stage: Protocol and metadata selection only; NO builds/source tuning/listening/metrics
execution.download_authorization: Root released CPU hold and explicitly authorized official archive download AFTER this protocol is written
execution.first_score_authorization: ROOT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED after selection/input provenance and one adapted harness freeze; no first scores during this task
execution.harness_rule: Prefer one private96-row harness importing frozen unchanged metric/noise functions with explicit candidate/baseline flags and fulltrace coupling. Only matrix/retainedfailure rows/provenance adaptations, no metric rewrite; freeze driver/source/probe/input manifests before ANY new scores
execution.attempts: One scoring pass per alreadyfrozen candidate. No source/threshold/fit/budget/model tuning after heldout, no rerun for desired outcomes. Infrastructure/metric failures preserve evidence and cannot change selection.
